answer: The horizon edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 144 clones produces a signature the quill analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. An hostile operator must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the saffron settlement applies the void retroactively. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
